node.constraint: Export default React component `Modal` accepting `open`, `onClose`, `title?`, `children` and `footer?`. Centered dialog with backdrop, closes on Esc/backdrop click, focus trap. Tailwind only, accessible (role=dialog aria-modal).

[DEFAULT STYLE] Fixed inset-0 z-50 grid place-items-center p-4. Backdrop bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm. Export default React component `Toast` (provider + useToast hook) accepting `variant` ('success'|'error'|'info'|'warning'), `title`, `description?`, auto-dismiss. Stacked bottom-right. Tailwind only.

Export default React component `Alert` accepting `variant` ('info'|'success'|'warning'|'error'), `title?`, `children` and `dismissible?`. Tailwind only, inline banner.

Export default React component `Tooltip` accepting `content` (ReactNode) and `children`, showing on hover/focus, positioned above by default. Tailwind only, accessible (aria-describedby).
